# WebStore Pro (Frinjo)

> Ecommerce website developer — online stores that sell. Custom websites for Pakistani businesses with Cash on Delivery, JazzCash/Easypaisa, and WhatsApp ordering.

WebStore Pro (https://frinjo.me, also known as Frinjo) is a web development service building ecommerce websites and online stores for small businesses, focused on the Pakistani market. Every website is mobile responsive and includes a shopping cart, checkout, and an admin panel on Business and Pro packages.

## Services

- Ecommerce Website — full online store with cart and checkout
- Business Website — company/service websites
- Admin Panel — manage products, prices, and orders yourself (no coding)
- Payment Integration — Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Stripe, PayPal, Binance Pay, Payoneer, USDT
- WhatsApp Ordering — customers order directly through WhatsApp
- SEO Basics — on-page SEO included in Pro package

## Pricing (one-time)

- Starter Website — $80 — 5-page website, up to 20 products, mobile responsive, shopping cart & checkout, Cash on Delivery setup, 5-day delivery, 7-day support
- Business Website — $150 (most popular) — everything in Starter, up to 100 products, admin panel, WhatsApp ordering + COD, order notifications, 7-day delivery, 14-day support
- Pro Website — $300 — everything in Business, payment gateway integration, custom banners & branding, order email alerts, SEO basics, 10-day delivery, 30-day priority support

## Key facts

- Website: https://frinjo.me
- Brand: WebStore Pro (Frinjo)
- Focus: ecommerce websites for Pakistani small businesses
- Tech: mobile-responsive websites (Next.js), tested on phones, tablets, and desktops
- Payments supported: Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Stripe, PayPal, WhatsApp ordering, Binance Pay, Payoneer, USDT
- Admin: Business and Pro packages include an admin panel to add products, change prices, and manage orders with zero coding
- Delivery: 5–10 days depending on package

## Common questions, answered

- How much does a website cost in Pakistan? WebStore Pro packages start at $80 (Starter), $150 (Business), $300 (Pro) — one-time pricing.
- How long does it take to build my website? 5 days (Starter), 7 days (Business), or 10 days (Pro).
- Will my website work on mobile phones? Yes — every website is fully mobile responsive and tested on phones, tablets, and desktops.
- Which payment methods are supported? Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Stripe, PayPal, WhatsApp ordering, Binance Pay, Payoneer, and USDT.
- Can I manage the website myself? Yes — Business and Pro packages include an admin panel to add products, change prices, and manage orders with zero coding.
- What do you need from me to start? Business name, logo (if any), product list with prices and photos, and your WhatsApp number.
- Landing page vs full website — which does my business need? A landing page suits a single offer or ad campaign; a full website suits businesses with multiple products or services. Full comparison: https://frinjo.me/blog/landing-page-vs-full-website-which-does-your-business-need
